biography.heading: BEHIND THE VISION
paragraphs: I'm Director Menny — a filmmaker, music video director, cinematographer, editor, and colorist with nearly a decade of experience shaping visuals from concept to final frame.

My work lives at the intersection of cinematic storytelling, music, visual culture, and technology. From directing and shooting music videos to crafting precise edits, cinematic color grades, and AI-generated visual worlds, I approach every project as an opportunity to build something distinctive.

I'm equally interested in the craft behind the camera and the possibilities emerging beyond it. I experiment with AI filmmaking, character consistency, cinematic world-building, and emerging creative tools to push visual ideas further.
I don't just edit footage. I build the atmosphere, rhythm, and visual identity that make a project memorable.
biography.closingQuote: My vision. My frames. My direction.

collaborations.heading: CREATIVE DISCIPLINES & COLLABORATIONS
paragraphs: My portfolio showcases my work across direction, cinematography, editing, color grading, and emerging AI-powered production workflows.
Each project is an opportunity to translate an idea, an artist's identity, or a musical emotion into a distinctive visual experience.
